title: Amex introduces a framework to prevent AI agents from making unauthorized purchases
slides: Can an AI agent empty your Amex?
Amex built a framework for agent payments.
But it doesn't verify the agent's identity.
Check if your card will be affected.
Ask your card issuer about agent policies.
thread_text:
1. Your Amex, Empty?

American Express built a payment framework for AI agents. But it doesn't verify who the agent really is.

2. The Framework Gap

Amex's system lets agents initiate transactions, but no identity verification. That means any agent could potentially drain your card.

3. Who's Liable?

If an unverified agent empties your account, who covers the loss? Your card issuer's policy on agent transactions is the only backstop.

4. Check Your Card

Not all cards have the same agent policies. Some issuers block agent payments entirely, others allow them with no safeguards.

5. Call Your Issuer

Ask your card issuer: what is your policy on AI agent transactions? Do it today before an agent tests it for you.
